text:
alex: Re-requesting review on https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4122 — addressed the kv rotation race you flagged, added a unit + a minimal e2e smoke, and updated the changelog. PTAL when you have a sec. I squashed the fix commits into one; happy to keep history instead if you'd prefer. Would like to merge before tomorrow's canary slot.
maria: Thanks — quick question: did you add a feature flag for the new rotation behavior?
alex: Yup, added `config.kv_rotate` (default: false). Note and example added to runtime/config.md. Pushed.
jordan: LGTM except for a tiny log-format nit — avoid printing the full shard metadata (can leak IDs). Change to `shard=%s` and we're good. Also please add a short perf note to the PR description (rough token/sec impact).
alex: Good catch, changed the log line to mask it and updated the PR description with a perf one-liner. Force-pushed the branch as a squash for cleanliness.
sam: FWIW I generally prefer keeping history (small separate commits are helpful when debugging). If people are ok with squash that's fine though.
alex: I can rebase instead if you all prefer — I already squashed and force-pushed. Happy to re-open with separate commits if someone wants it preserved.
maria: For this tiny fix squash is fine. Approved from me after CI green. :+1:
ci-bot: CI started for alex/fix-kv-rotation (jobs: unit,e2e,lint)
alex: Thanks — monitoring.
deploy-bot: Canary slot available 2026-03-19 20:00 UTC. Will queue rollout after merge if requested.
maria: Quick FYI — smoke run locally found an intermittent kv_allocator_test flake. I pushed a flaky-annotate change to avoid blocking this merge; we should follow up and stabilize the test in a separate PR.
alex: I added a short TODO in the PR and noted the follow-up in the backlog. Kept the flaky annotation minimal.
jordan: Approved — thanks for the quick turnaround.
ci-bot: All checks passed for alex/fix-kv-rotation.
alex: Merged and tagged `release/runtime-fix-4122`. Will queue canary with deploy-bot. Thanks everyone!
deploy-bot: Canary queued for 2026-03-19 20:00 UTC (PR 4122).
